situations.name: Bandara & Imigrasi
situations.context: At an airport: immigration counter, customs, check-in desk, baggage claim, boarding gates. The other person is usually an officer or airline staff.
phrases: Saya akan tinggal selama tujuh hari.

situations.name: Hotel
situations.context: At a hotel: front desk, reservation, check-in/check-out, room problems, hotel facilities. The other person is hotel staff.
phrases: Saya mau check-in. Saya sudah memesan kamar.
AC di kamar saya tidak berfungsi.
Boleh saya titip koper setelah check-out?

situations.name: Restoran
situations.context: At a restaurant or food stall: ordering, dietary needs (halal, allergies, no pork/alcohol), spice level, paying the bill. The other person is a waiter or cashier.
phrases: Apakah ini mengandung babi atau alkohol?

situations.name: Transportasi
situations.context: Getting around: taxi, ride-hailing, train, subway, bus, tickets, directions, fares. The other person is a driver, station staff or a passer-by.
phrases: Tolong antar saya ke alamat ini.
Di mana saya bisa membeli tiket?

situations.name: Belanja
situations.context: Shopping: shops, markets, prices, bargaining, sizes, fitting rooms, receipts, tax refund. The other person is a shop assistant or seller.
phrases: Apakah ada ukuran yang lebih besar?

situations.name: Darurat & Kesehatan
situations.context: Emergency or health: asking for help, police, hospital, pharmacy, lost passport or belongings, symptoms. Be clear and direct; accuracy matters more than politeness.
phrases: Teman saya sakit dan butuh dokter.
